Easy roast chicken
With lemon, fresh herbs & veg trivet
Save recipe
1 hr 25 mins plus resting time
Super easy
serves 4
About the recipe
This is a super-reliable roast chicken recipe to give you juicy meat and crispy skin, every time. Perfect.

Ingredients
1 x 1.6kg whole free-range chicken
2 medium onions
2 carrots
2 sticks of celery
1 bulb of garlic
olive oil
1 lemon
1 bunch of mixed fresh herbs such as thyme, rosemary, bay
